About Buddies

Made for sweet moments.

Buddies is an ice cream and dessert destination built around great flavors, indulgent creations and moments shared with friends and family. From loaded waffles to signature frappes, every item on the menu is made to turn an ordinary stop into a sweet one.

The Buddies experience is simple: bold blue-and-white branding, generous portions, and a menu built for sharing — whether that's a quick cone on the way home or a full loaded sundae with the whole table involved.
